title: Conditions raised by zunpy — zunpy-conditions
text: Every error zunpy raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zunpy_error. Offsets 0-based byte offsets input; .npz count start member, member names .

title: Conditions raised by zunpy — zunpy-conditions
text: zunpy_invalid_argument argument unusable, including dtype value reach. Carries arg. zunpy_parse_error input .npy .npz: bad magic string, version, header grammar descr, truncated trailing data. Carries offset. zunpy_invalid_error input well formed inconsistent: shape disagrees data length, fields overlap, U string holds surrogate, checksum match. Carries offset. zunpy_unsupported_type dtype R value counterpart: object arrays, long doubles, nested structured dtypes. Carries dtype. zunpy_unrepresentable value R hold: dimension 2^31 - 1, 64-bit integer beyond 2^53 read double. Carries offset index. zunpy_na_error NA representation target. Carries index. zunpy_range_error value fit requested dtype. Carries index. zunpy_limit_error limit reached. Carries limit, argument's name, limit_value. subclasses zunpy_size_limit, zunpy_header_limit, zunpy_dims_limit zunpy_members_limit. zunpy_io_error file connection read written.

text: Read write array files 'NumPy', '.npy' one array '.npz' 'ZIP' archive , R vectors, matrices, arrays data frames, without 'Python'. Numeric, boolean, complex, half-precision, string, date-time structured types supported. Every header parsed checked bytes present anything allocated, every value converted exactly refused; writing deterministic matches output 'NumPy'.
